player_prompt.intro:
Sika'y Manag-ayam {player_id} ed Stratego.
Say tuyo mo'y mangkapot ed bandera na kalaban mo o mangilako'y amin da'y naiyakar na piraso.
Say impan mo'y inayakar ed sakey ya tabla para sika, kaiba'y bandera mo, bomba, tan piraso na saray ranggo.

### Panag-ayam
1. **Panag-ayam:**
   - Ed say oras mo, sika'y makapan-ayam na sakey ya piraso na sakey ya agew ed sakey ya kuwadro (baba, ngato, kawigi, o kawanan) ya inayakar na saray piraso mo.
   - Halimbawa: Sakey ya piraso'y makapan-ayam ed A1 to B1 o A1 to A2 no B1 tan A2 et ag-inaayakar na saray piraso na manag-ayam.
   - No say napili'y bomba o bandera, ag-makapan-ayam.
2. **Labanan:**
   - No sika'y makapan-ayam ed sakey ya kuwadro ya inayakar na kalaban mo, say labanan'y maganap:
     - Say piraso ya mas mataas ya ranggo'y manalo tan mangilako'y piraso na kalaban.
     - No say ranggo'y pareho, saray piraso'y maalis ed tabla.
     - **Saray Kaso:**
       - Saray bomba'y mangilako'y saray piraso ya man-ataki maliban ed Miner, ya makapan-defuse bomba.
       - Saray Spy'y makapan-ayam ed Marshal no say Spy'y una'y man-ataki pero matalo ed amin da'y piraso.
3. **Tuyo:**
   - I-identify mo'y saray piraso na kalaban mo ed saray panag-ayam da tan labanan.
   - Protektahan mo'y bandera mo mientras sika'y mang-ataki ed bandera na kalaban mo.
   - Usaren mo'y saray Scout strategically para mangala'y impormasyon ed saray piraso na kalaban mo tan mang-ataki'y maluya.

### Panag-ayam:
1. I-specify mo'y koordinado na piraso ya sika'y man-ayam tan destinasyon to.
2. Usaren mo'y format: [A0 B0], no A0 so source position, tan B0 so destinasyon.
   - Halimbawa: Para man-ayam ed piraso ed row 0, column 0 to row 1, column 0, input [A0 B0].
3. Sigurado'y destinasyon ya valid ed panag-ayam ed baba.

### Mahalaga:
- Say tabla'y ipapakita'y saray piraso mo tan posisyon da, e.g. MN, MS.
- Say tabla'y ipapakita'y saray posisyon ya kalaban mo ya kilala, e.g. ?.
- Saray grid ya ~ et danaw tan ag-makapan-ayam.
- Bilang suhestiyon, umpisa'y man-ayam mo'y saray piraso ya sika'y naiyakar ed frontline para mangala'y impormasyon ed saray piraso na kalaban mo. Manag-ayam 0 tan manag-ayam 1's frontline so row D tan G, respectively.

Saya'y kurrenti tabla:

invalid_move.wrong_format: Say aksyon et sali. Say {player_id} player et diad input so move ed format [A0 B0].
invalid_move.invalid_coordinates: Invalid action format. Player {player_id} did not input valid coordinates. Ag-inmakar so player ed say dugan koordinat na saray gawa to, tan agmet inmakto iray kodidata ya walad listaan da ray gagala ra.
invalid_move.not_own_piece: Say format na aksion et aliwan valid. Kaukolan ya iyalis na sakey ed saray piraso to so manlalaban {player_id} .
invalid_move.scout_through_pieces: Invalid action format. Say player {player_id} so agnayarin mangiyalis na scout ed arum ya piraso.
invalid_move.scout_diagonal: Invalid action format. Manag-ayam {player_id} ag-makapan-ayam ed Scout diagonally.
invalid_move.non_scout_multi_square: Aliwan dugan format na aksion. Saray piraso, likud ed saray espiya, so nayarin mangiyalis labat na sakey a kuwadro kada pankanawnawa.
invalid_move.move_into_lake: Invalid action format. Manag-ayam {player_id} ag-makapan-ayam ed danaw.
invalid_move.move_onto_own_piece: Aliwan dugan format na kiwas. Say manlalaban {player_id} so agnayarin onalis ed mismon piraso to.
invalid_move.move_bomb_or_flag: Invalid action format. Player {player_id} can't move a bomb or flag. Say player ya agga makatilak na bomba odino bandira so nayarin man-switch ed sakey tan sakey diad loob na pigay minuto, balet say player ya agak makaalis et walay pankanawnawan mangibaki na bala to.

game_action.you_moved: Nayun mo so piece mo manlapud {source} ed {dest}.
game_action.opponent_moved: Say manlalako {player_id} so angiyalis na piraso manlapud {source} ya anggad {dest}.
game_action.you_equal_ranks: Nayun mo so piece mo manlapud {source} ed {dest}. Say atakeng piece et {attacking_rank} tan say destinasyon piece et {target_rank}. No say ranggo da et saman, duara so piece et napan.
game_action.opponent_equal_ranks: Say {player_id} player et nanayun ed saray piece manlapud {source} ed {dest}. Say atakeng piece et {attacking_rank} tan say destinasyon piece et {target_rank}. No say ranggo da et saman, duara so piece et napan.
game_action.you_miner_defused: Nayun mo so piece mo manlapud {source} ed {dest}. Say atakeng piece et {attacking_rank} tan say destinasyon piece et {target_rank}. No say miner et makapag-defuse ed bomb, kaiban mo so laban.
game_action.opponent_miner_defused: Say ogawad si {player_id} na iyakar so piece to manlapas {source} ed {dest}. Say ogawad a piece et {attacking_rank} tan say destinasyon a piece et {target_rank}. Lapu ed miner so kaya danuman so bomba, abayag ka la so laban.
game_action.you_bomb_lost: Inyalis mo so pirasom manlapud {source} papuntang {dest}. Say piraso a nan-ataki et {attacking_rank} tan say piraso a dinatayan et {target_rank}. Diad ta say nan-ataki et aliwa sakey a minero, natalo kay ed say laban.
game_action.opponent_bomb_won: Say player {player_id} inyalis na sakey a piraso manlapud {source} papuntang {dest}. Say piraso a nan-ataki et {attacking_rank} tan say piraso a dinatayan et {target_rank}. Diad ta say nan-ataki et aliwa sakey a minero, sikatoy nanalo ed say laban.
game_action.you_spy_won: Nayun mo so piece mo manlapud {source} ed {dest}. Say atakeng piece et {attacking_rank} tan say destinasyon piece et {target_rank}. No diad ataker so spy tan say destinasyon so marshall, kaiban mo so laban.
game_action.opponent_spy_lost: Say ogawad si {player_id} na iyakar so piece to manlapas {source} ed {dest}. Say ogawad a piece et {attacking_rank} tan say destinasyon a piece et {target_rank}. Lapu ed ogawad et ispy tan say destinasyon et marshall, abayag ka la so laban.
game_action.you_higher_won: Nayun mo so piece mo manlapud {source} ed {dest}. Say atakeng piece et {attacking_rank} tan say destinasyon piece et {target_rank}. No diad ataker so masanto ed ranggo ed say destinasyon, kaiban mo so laban.
game_action.opponent_higher_lost: Say ogawad si {player_id} na iyakar so piece to manlapas {source} ed {dest}. Say ogawad a piece et {attacking_rank} tan say destinasyon a piece et {target_rank}. Lapu ed ogawad et mas atagey so rango to kumpara ed destinasyon, abayag ka la so laban.
game_action.you_lower_lost: Nayun mo so piece mo manlapud {source} ed {dest}. Say atakeng piece et {attacking_rank} tan say destinasyon piece et {target_rank}. No diad ataker so abalo ed ranggo ed say destinasyon, kaiban mo so laban.
game_action.opponent_lower_won: Say player {player_id} inyalis na sakey a piraso manlapud {source} papuntang {dest}. Say piraso a nan-ataki et {attacking_rank} tan say piraso a dinatayan et {target_rank}. Diad ta say nan-ataki et mas baba so ranggo to ed say dinatayan, sikatoy nanalo ed say laban.

outcome.flag_captured: Say manlalaban {player_id} so angala ed bandira na kalaban!
outcome.no_movable_pieces: Manangaro ya si Manlalaro {winner_id}! Say Manlalaro {loser_id} walay natan saray pieza ya makakalaw.
